WITH track_counts AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) as track_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY PlaylistId
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist) as total_playlists,
    COALESCE(SUM(track_count), 0) as total_tracks
  FROM track_counts
)
SELECT 
  p.PlaylistId,
  COALESCE(tc.track_count, 0) as track_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.total_tracks = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(tc.track_count, 0) * 1.0 * s.total_playlists / s.total_tracks
  END as ratio
FROM Playlist p
LEFT JOIN track_counts tc ON p.PlaylistId = tc.PlaylistId
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
